quantity.description: Quantity of item to be ordered.

sku.description: The SKU of the item to be ordered.

customItemName.description: The custom name to be used, if overwriting is permitted for this item.

customItemPrice.description: The custom price to be used, if custom pricing is permitted for this item.

discountAmountOverride.description: The custom discount amount applied to this item. Only one of `discountAmountOverride` or `discountPercentOverride` can be set. Must be used in conjunction with a [discountCode](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/operation/operation-apelocalorder#operation-apelocalorder-body-application-json-items-discountcode) and this discount must be configured as a "manual discount" in the POS. See [Understanding Discounts](https://k-series-support.lightspeedhq.com/hc/en-us/articles/1260804657089-Understanding-discounts).

discountPercentOverride.description: The custom percentage discount applied to this item. Only one of `discountAmountOverride` or `discountPercentOverride` can be set. Must be used in conjunction with a [discountCode](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/operation/operation-apelocalorder#operation-apelocalorder-body-application-json-items-discountcode) and this discount must be configured as a "manual discount" in the POS. See [Understanding Discounts](https://k-series-support.lightspeedhq.com/hc/en-us/articles/1260804657089-Understanding-discounts).

modifiers.description: Collection of [modifiers](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/operation/operation-apeloadallmodifiers) to be applied to this item.

discountCode.description: The discount code being applied to this item, if applicable.

course.description: The course number for this item, if applicable.

subItems.description: The sub-items applied to this item.

modifierId.description: Modifier ID to be applied to this item.

quantity.description: Quantity of sub-item to be ordered.

sku.description: The SKU of the sub-item to be ordered.

customItemName.description: The custom name to be used if overwriting is supported for this sub-item.

customItemPrice.description: The custom price to be used if overwriting is supported for this sub-item.

modifiers.description: Collection of modifiers to be applied to this sub-item.

subItems.description: Product modifiers applied to this item.
